en_us.132207_fluff: We'll cut you up, boy. A fine broth you'll make.
en_us.132207_tooltip: <keyword=summon>Summon</keyword> Whispess and Weavess to this row.
en_us.132208_fluff: I sense your pain. I see your fear.
en_us.132208_tooltip: <keyword=summon>Summon</keyword> Brewess and Whispess to this row.
en_us.132209_fluff: One of the world's oldest and deadliest monsters. I used to feel excitement at moments like this. Now the beast is only an obstacle in my way. Its meat and hot blood will help me survive this icy hell.
en_us.132210_fluff: Can't stand the heat? Then you don't stand a chance.
en_us.132210_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> {Counter} Lesser Ifrits to the right of this unit.
en_us.132211_fluff: Take heed, gents, there's nekkers under this here bridge.
en_us.132211_tooltip: Choose a Bronze ally and add {Counter} copies of it to the bottom of your deck.
en_us.132212_fluff: Fled one time in my life. From the Ice Giant. And I'm not a bit ashamed.
en_us.132212_tooltip: Boost by {Boost} if Biting Frost is anywhere on the board.
en_us.132213_fluff: How do you fight an earth elemental? You don't. You run. Fast as you can.
en_us.132214_fluff: Each Wild Hunt warrior has gone through a rigorous selection process, but Eredin's personal cavalcade includes only the most brutal and most ferocious of the Aen Elle.
en_us.132214_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy. Increase damage by {Damage2} for each Wild Hunt unit in your hand.
en_us.132215_fluff: He always grants exactly what you wish for. That's the problem.
en_us.132215_tooltip: Gamble with Gaunter: Guess the power of the card he's picked to play it.
en_us.132216_fluff: Big, bad, ugly. Squats in the sewers.
en_us.132216_tooltip: Draw a unit, then <keyword=consume>Consume</keyword> a unit in your hand and boost self by its power.
en_us.132217_fluff: Common harpies feed on carrion. Celaeno harpies… they feed on dreams.
en_us.132217_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> {Counter} Harpy Eggs to the left of this unit.
en_us.132218_tooltip: <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> all your other Ogroids in hand, deck, and on board by {Strengthen}.
en_us.132220_fluff: Drinking the blood of the Continent since the Conjunction.
en_us.132301_fluff: Fog creeps on little cat feet. Foglets creep over the bodies of their victims.
en_us.132301_tooltip: Whenever you apply Impenetrable Fog to an enemy row, <keyword=summon>Summon</keyword> a copy of this unit to the opposite row.
en_us.132302_fluff: Many primal fears lurk in the hearts of men. The fear of the mist is well–founded…
en_us.132302_tooltip: Boost by {Boost} if Impenetrable Fog is on the board on turn end.
en_us.132303_fluff: Imagine a cross between a winged snake and a nightmare. Wyverns are worse.
en_us.132304_fluff: Ugly – nature's way of saying "stay away."
en_us.132304_tooltip: <keyword=summon>Summon</keyword> all copies of this unit to this row.
en_us.132305_fluff: These little guys are almost cute, if you ignore the whole vicious killer aspect.
en_us.132305_tooltip: If in hand, deck, or on board, boost self by {Boost} whenever you <keyword=consume>Consume</keyword> a card.\n<keyword=deathwish>Deathwish:</keyword> <keyword=summon>Summon</keyword> a copy of this unit to the same position.
en_us.132306_fluff: If ghouls are part of the Circle of Life… then it's one vicious circle.
en_us.132306_tooltip: <keyword=consume>Consume</keyword> a Bronze or Silver unit from your graveyard and boost self by its power.
en_us.132307_fluff: It's a griffin, just more… griffiny.
en_us.132308_fluff: They sat still on their horses, seemingly relaxed. He saw their weapons – short spears with wide tips. Swords with oddly forged guards. Battle axes. Toothed gisarmes.
en_us.132308_tooltip: <keyword=consume>Consume</keyword> the unit to the right and boost self by its power.\nEvery {Counter} turns, repeat its ability on turn start.
en_us.132309_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy. If the enemy is destroyed or is under Biting Frost, boost self by {Boost}.
en_us.132310_fluff: First the buffalo horns atop their helms penetrate one's view, then the crest betwixt them, and finally the skull–like face exposed beneath their visors.
en_us.132310_tooltip: Increase the damage dealt by Biting Frost on the opposite row by {Damage}.
en_us.132312_fluff: Griffins like to toy with their prey. Eat 'em alive, piece by piece.
en_us.132312_tooltip: Trigger the <keyword=deathwish>Deathwish</keyword> of a Bronze ally.
en_us.132313_fluff: Who would think that overgrown bats would have a taste for gaudy jewelry?
en_us.132314_fluff: Though the witchman lusts for gold, for the smiting of a drowner thou shalt give him but a silver penny, or three halfpence, at most.
en_us.132314_tooltip: Move an enemy to the row opposite this unit and deal {Damage} damage to it. If that row is under a <keyword=hazard>Hazard</keyword>, deal 4 damage instead.
en_us.132315_fluff: There are many species of harpy, and all are kleptomaniacs.
en_us.132315_tooltip: Whenever you destroy an allied Beast, <keyword=summon>Summon</keyword> a copy of this unit to the same position.
en_us.132316_fluff: A harpy egg omelet - a delicious delicacy, good sir. Quite dear, too, for as you might surmise, the wretches don't part with their eggs willingly.
en_us.132316_tooltip: When <keyword=consume>Consumed</keyword>, boost <keyword=consume>Consuming</keyword> unit by {Boost}.\n<keyword=deathwish>Deathwish:</keyword> <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> a Harpy Hatchling on a random row.
en_us.132402_fluff: Cry 'Havoc!', and let slip the dogs of war.
en_us.132402_tooltip: Play Biting Frost from your deck.
en_us.132403_fluff: "Relax, I know how to tame wolves…"– Dunbar the Hunter's last words.
en_us.132404_fluff: A certain mage thought them cute. It was his fate that gave rise to the saying "Don't play with fire…"
en_us.132404_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to a random enemy.
en_us.132405_fluff: They're easily mistaken for rocks. Many a troll's been unpleasantly surprised by gastric grief on that very account.
en_us.132406_fluff: Fear not the shadows, but the light.
en_us.132406_tooltip: Play a Bronze <keyword=deathwish>Deathwish</keyword> unit from your deck.
en_us.132407_fluff: The most powerful of Nilfgaard's mages have mastered the art of creating golems. On a few occasions, they've even managed to make them fight for the imperial cause…
en_us.132407_tooltip: <keyword=summon>Summon</keyword> a copy of this unit to a random row whenever you <keyword=reveal>Reveal</keyword> a card in your opponent's hand.
en_us.132408_fluff: Oh, you're in a heap of trouble now…
en_us.132408_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to {MaxTargets} random enemies on the opposite row.
en_us.132409_fluff: The fool paid heed to superstition, stuffed his ears with wax and didn't hear the warnings. He ran his ship straight into the rocks.
en_us.132409_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy. If the enemy is under Blood Moon, deal {Damage2} damage instead.
en_us.133301_fluff: Stronger than your average shield and far more stylish.
en_us.133301_tooltip: Boost a unit by the base power of a Bronze or Silver unit in your hand.
en_us.133302_fluff: Damn, the filth's o'errun us… We need a witcher or there's no livin' 'ere!
en_us.133302_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> a Bronze Necrophage or Insectoid and boost it by {Boost}.
en_us.142101_fluff: I inherited my father's ability to assume other forms - well, one other form, in my case.
en_us.142101_tooltip: Boost self by {Boost} for each Dwarf ally and deal {Damage} damage to an enemy for each Elf ally.
en_us.142102_fluff: It dawns on them once they notice my scar: a realization of imminent death.
en_us.142102_tooltip: Play a Bronze or Silver <keyword=ambush>Ambush</keyword> from your deck.
en_us.142103_fluff: King or beggar, what's the difference? One dh'oine less.
en_us.142103_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy. If the unit was destroyed, boost all Elves in your hand by {Boost}.
en_us.142104_fluff: With each arrow I loose, I think of my da. He'd be proud. I think.
en_us.142104_tooltip: Return each player's <keyword=highest>Highest</keyword> Bronze or Silver unit to their deck.
en_us.142105_fluff: Drinkin' alone's like crappin' with company.
en_us.142105_tooltip: Choose {MaxTargets} units. <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> allies by {Strengthen} and move them to this row. Deal {Damage} damage to enemies and move them to the row opposite this unit.
en_us.142106_fluff: Brokilon bleeds… and not even I can heal it.
en_us.142106_tooltip: <keyword=resurrect>Resurrect</keyword> a Bronze or Silver special card from your opponent's graveyard, then <keyword=banish>Banish</keyword> it.
en_us.142107_fluff: Famed for constantly prophesying the world's doom. Not much fun at parties.
en_us.142107_tooltip: Play a Bronze Spell, <keyword=boon>Boon</keyword> or <keyword=hazard>Hazard</keyword> from your deck twice.
en_us.142108_fluff: Time to look death in the face.
en_us.142201_fluff: I know how to execute orders, so take your advice somewhere else.
en_us.142201_tooltip: <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> all your other Dwarves in hand, deck, and on board by {Strengthen}.
en_us.142202_fluff: I am a Sage. My power lies in possessing knowledge. Not sharing it.
en_us.142202_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> Impenetrable Fog, Clear Skies or Alzur's Thunder.
en_us.142203_fluff: We are the drops of rain that together make a ferocious storm.
en_us.142203_tooltip: <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>.\n<keyword=fatigue>Single-Use:</keyword> Draw a special card and a unit. Keep one and return the other to your deck.
en_us.142204_fluff: I'd gladly kill you from up close, stare in your eyes… But you reek, human.
en_us.142204_tooltip: <keyword=ambush>Ambush:</keyword> When your opponent passes, flip over and boost {MaxTargets} units on each side by {Boost}.
en_us.142205_fluff: Most terrible things I've witnessed? The Catriona plague, the razing of Vengerberg and the charge of the Vrihedd Dragoons.
en_us.142205_tooltip: Boost a random non-<keyword=spying>Spying</keyword> unit in your hand by {Boost} on turn end.
en_us.142206_fluff: The path to freedom is paved in blood, not ink.
en_us.142206_tooltip: Toggle a unit's <keyword=lock>Lock</keyword> status and move it to this row on its side.
en_us.142207_fluff: Our mead smells rotten to ye, do it? Easy to fix – I'll break yer nose!
en_us.142207_tooltip: Play a random Bronze or Silver Dwarf from your deck and <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> it by {Strengthen}.
en_us.142208_fluff: Lady Eithné's daughter had inherited her sublime beauty and her wild hatred for all that is human.
en_us.142208_tooltip: <keyword=ambush>Ambush:</keyword> When a unit is played on your opponent's side, flip over and deal {Damage} damage to it.
en_us.142209_fluff: Mona…? No… no. I'm Braenn. A daughter of Brokilon.
en_us.142209_tooltip: Deal damage equal to this unit's power. If a unit was destroyed, boost all your other Dryads and <keyword=ambush>Ambush</keyword> units in hand, deck, and on board by {Boost}.
en_us.142210_fluff: I hate you, dh'oine. You are all the same.
en_us.142210_tooltip: <keyword=ambush>Ambush:</keyword> After {Counter} turns, flip over and <keyword=charm>Charm</keyword> the <keyword=highest>Highest</keyword> Bronze or Silver enemy with {Power} power or less on turn start.
en_us.142211_fluff: Better to die standing than to live on bent knee.
en_us.142211_tooltip: If {MaxTargets} Elf allies are on the board on any turn end, <keyword=summon>Summon</keyword> this unit to a random row.
en_us.142212_fluff: I was there, on the front lines! Right where the fightin' was the thickest!
en_us.142212_tooltip: Move all allies on this row to random rows and boost self by {Boost} for each.
en_us.142213_fluff: Ever hear o' the dragon Ocvist? From Quartz Mountain? Well, Yarpen Zigrin and his band o' dwarves did 'im in.
en_us.142213_tooltip: <keyword=resilient>Resilience</keyword>.\nWhenever a Dwarf ally appears, boost self by {Boost}.
en_us.142214_fluff: Love justifies madness in any of its forms.
en_us.142214_tooltip: Whenever you draw this unit or return it to your deck, boost self by {Boost}.
en_us.142301_fluff: Sure, I'll patch you up. Gonna cost you though.
en_us.142302_tooltip: Clear <keyword=hazard>Hazards</keyword> from its row and move a unit to this row on its side.
en_us.142303_fluff: Hatred burns brighter than any fire, and cuts deeper than any blade.
en_us.142303_tooltip: <keyword=swap>Swap</keyword> a card and boost self by its base power.
en_us.142304_fluff: They track like hounds, run like deer and kill like heartless demons.
en_us.142304_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> an Incinerating Trap on an enemy row.
en_us.142305_fluff: Worked a pickaxe all me life. Battleaxe won't be any trouble.
en_us.142305_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy. If the unit was not destroyed, boost self by {Boost}.
en_us.142306_fluff: I'm telling ye, we're born fer battle – we slash straight at their knees!
en_us.142307_fluff: No matter what you may have heard, elves don't take human scalps. Too much lice.
en_us.142307_tooltip: <keyword=ambush>Ambush:</keyword> After {Counter} turns, flip over on turn start.
en_us.142308_fluff: I spit on Scoia'tael ideals, but not on their coin.
en_us.142308_tooltip: Look at {Size} random Bronze special cards from your deck, then play {MaxTargets}.
en_us.142309_fluff: Temerians, Redanians, all the same. Better off dead.
en_us.142309_tooltip:
Boost Elf allies by {Boost}.
Whenever you <keyword=swap>Swap</keyword> this card, trigger its ability.
en_us.142310_fluff: Take another step, dh'oine. You'd look better with an arrow between your eyes.
en_us.142311_fluff: The key's mixin' pleasure an' business – like smackin' foes and gettin' coin for it.
en_us.142311_tooltip: Move a unit to this row on its side. If it's an ally, boost it by {Boost}.
en_us.142312_fluff: Elf, dwarf, makes no difference – long as they've got coin.
en_us.142312_tooltip: Boost a unit in your hand by {Boost}.
en_us.142313_fluff: You mean to say the she–elf danced amidst the fray? Have you lost your mind, corporal?!
en_us.142313_tooltip: Whenever you <keyword=swap>Swap</keyword> this unit, play it automatically on a random row.
en_us.142314_fluff: You might manage to hide from them, but once spotted, don't bother trying to run.
en_us.142314_tooltip:
Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy.
Whenever an enemy moves, deal {Damage} damage to it.
Whenever this unit moves, deal {Damage} damage to a random enemy.
en_us.142315_fluff: I fight for whoever's paying the best. Or whoever's easiest to rob.
en_us.142315_tooltip: Whenever an enemy appears, boost self by {Boost}.
en_us.142316_fluff: By the time we'd heard them, it was already too late…
en_us.142316_tooltip:
<keyword=summon>Summon</keyword> all copies of this unit to this row.
Whenever this unit moves, boost it by {Boost}.
en_us.142317_fluff: Only one punishment for disturbin' the peace in Mahakam: a hammer to the heid.
en_us.142401_fluff: Many nonhumans, fed up with the racism and xenophobia they encounter in the cities, decide to join the Scoia'tael.
en_us.142401_tooltip: Boost {MaxTargets} random units in your hand by {Boost}.
en_us.143201_fluff: You exact from the earth a blood ransom, ripping out its riches by force. To us it bloomed, bore fruit and gave freely, for it loved us as we loved it.
en_us.143201_tooltip: Play a Bronze or Silver special card from your deck.
en_us.143301_fluff: Careful…! One more step and you'll be turned into molten glass.
en_us.143301_tooltip: <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>.\nDamage all other units on its row by {Damage} and <keyword=banish>Banish</keyword> self on turn end.
en_us.152101_fluff: Instead of mournin' the fallen, let's drink to their memory!
en_us.152101_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> the Lord of Undvik on the opposite row.
en_us.152103_fluff: Only the ignorant dismiss the importance of myths.
en_us.152104_fluff: When the time comes, the cockerel Kambi shall crow and awaken Hemdall.
en_us.152104_tooltip: <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>.\n<keyword=deathwish>Deathwish:</keyword> <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> Hemdall on a random row on this unit's side.
en_us.152105_fluff: Skellige must have a strong king. No matter what it takes.
en_us.152105_tooltip: Apply Skellige Storm to an enemy row.
en_us.152106_tooltip: <keyword=discard>Discard</keyword> a Bronze unit from your deck, then deal damage equal to its base power to an enemy.
en_us.152107_fluff: Her true name's Astrid Lyttneyd Ásgeirrfinnbjornsdottir, but that never fit on any forms.
en_us.152107_tooltip: Transform a Bronze or Silver unit into a Jade Figurine.
en_us.152109_fluff: Merely mention this name to a Nilfgaardian, and they'll feel a spreading warmth in their knickers…
en_us.152109_tooltip:
On turn end, <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> the unit to the left by {Strengthen}, then deal {Damage} damage to the unit to the right.
{Armor} <keyword=armor>Armor</keyword>.
en_us.152201_fluff: I'm near ready to puke from boredom.
en_us.152201_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> a Spectral Whale on an enemy row.
en_us.152202_fluff: He'll not reveal his name till he's defeated. He's a troll errant, see?
en_us.152203_fluff: When a warrant says "dead or alive," most bounty hunters'll just kill you. Not me. Should I catch you, you'll hang, and I'll tickle your feet as you expire.
en_us.152203_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to {MaxTargets} allies and <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> self by {Strengthen} for each.
en_us.152204_fluff: I've gathered all the jarls together. Now make your case.
en_us.152204_tooltip: Toggle a unit's <keyword=lock>Lock</keyword> status, then move a Bronze unit from your opponent's graveyard to yours.
en_us.152205_fluff: Hear ye now the tale of the heroic deeds of Clan an Craite.
en_us.152205_tooltip: <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> {MaxTargets} non-Leader units in your graveyard by {Strengthen}.
en_us.152206_fluff: An archdruid, a master of alchemy, and the grumpiest old fart in the Isles.
en_us.152206_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> Torrential Rain, Clear Skies or Bloodcurdling Roar.
en_us.152207_fluff: Now let's drink to the Emperor of Nilfgaard – may he die of somethin' hideous!
en_us.152207_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage. If the unit was destroyed, <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> the <keyword=highest>Highest</keyword> unit in your graveyard by {Strengthen}.
en_us.152209_fluff: The vilest man Skellige's ever known.
en_us.152209_tooltip: Whenever <keyword=discard>Discarded</keyword>, <keyword=resurrect>Resurrect</keyword> on a random row; and whenever destroyed, <keyword=resurrect>Resurrect</keyword> in the same position. Then, <keyword=weaken>Weaken</keyword> self by half.
en_us.152210_fluff: "Tame"? Och, lad, Skelligers might train bears, but that don't at all mean they tame 'em…
en_us.152210_tooltip: Whenever a unit is played from either hand on your opponent's side, deal {Damage} damage to it.
en_us.152211_fluff: Fall on your knees and beg Modron Freya for forgiveness.
en_us.152211_tooltip: <keyword=resurrect>Resurrect</keyword> a Bronze or Silver Clan unit.
en_us.152213_fluff: The emperor also thought him an accidental king. At first.
en_us.152213_tooltip: Draw a card, then <keyword=discard>Discard</keyword> a card.
en_us.152214_fluff: The gods have spoken: a sacrifice is required.
en_us.152214_tooltip: <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>.\n<keyword=fatigue>Single-Use:</keyword> Look at {Size} cards from your deck. Draw one and <keyword=discard>Discard</keyword> the other.
en_us.152301_fluff: In their ballads skalds claim you cannot tell a berserker changed in the heat of battle from a true–born bear.
en_us.152301_tooltip: When this unit is damaged or <keyword=weaken>Weakened</keyword>, transform into a Raging Bear.
en_us.152302_fluff: Now finish your soup, or a berserker'll come and swallow ye whole.
en_us.152302_tooltip: Boost self by {Boost} for each damaged or Cursed ally.
en_us.152303_fluff: Our clan's bards will sing of my deeds long after you're dead and forgotten!
en_us.152304_fluff: Better believe we can hunt. Thing is, not much game on Spikeroog…
en_us.152305_fluff: Can see the fear in their eyes. Fear o' me… fear o' Clan Dimun!
en_us.152305_tooltip: <keyword=discard>Discard</keyword> all copies of this unit from your deck.
en_us.152306_fluff: Haul together, hoist the colors high!
en_us.152306_tooltip: Play a different Bronze Dimun unit from your deck.
en_us.152307_fluff: The queen is guarded by the hardiest and fiercest shieldmaidens Skellige's ever known.
en_us.152307_tooltip: <keyword=resurrect>Resurrect</keyword> all copies of this unit on this row.
en_us.152308_fluff: The deeds of Clan Heymaey will go down in history.
en_us.152308_tooltip: Boost all allies from a Clan of your choice by {Boost}.
en_us.152309_fluff: Escape them? In the waters of Skellige? Good luck.
en_us.152309_tooltip: On turn end, deal {Damage} damage to the unit to the right, then boost self by {Boost}.
en_us.152310_fluff: Modron Freya, the Great Mother, is the goddess of love, beauty and bounty.
en_us.152311_fluff: Remember me words – a good shield can save yer life.
en_us.152311_tooltip: <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> an ally by {Strengthen} and give it {Armor} <keyword=armor>Armor</keyword>.
en_us.152312_fluff: Swords are for wenches. Get yourself an axe.
en_us.152312_tooltip:
Whenever an enemy on the opposite row is damaged, boost self by {Boost}.
{Armor} <keyword=armor>Armor</keyword>.
en_us.152313_fluff: Friends we show heart, foes we show our axe. Remember that.
en_us.152313_tooltip: Whenever this unit is <keyword=resurrect>Resurrected</keyword>, <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> it by {Strengthen}.
en_us.152314_fluff: They say Hemdall's heart swells whenever the longships sail out on a raid.
en_us.152314_tooltip:
Deal {Damage} damage to a random enemy.
Repeat this ability whenever you <keyword=discard>Discard</keyword> a card.
en_us.152315_fluff: So ye can hit a movin' target at two hundred paces? Me, too. In a storm.
en_us.152316_fluff: We are An Craite! What others buy with gold, we buy with our lifeblood.
en_us.152316_tooltip: Whenever you <keyword=discard>Discard</keyword> this unit, <keyword=resurrect>Resurrect</keyword> it on a random row.
en_us.152318_fluff: They'll shatter on our shields like waves on a craggy shore.
en_us.152318_tooltip: <keyword=summon>Summon</keyword> all copies of this unit to this row.
en_us.152401_fluff: This master turned the isle of Undvik, once home to the proud Clan Tordarroch, into a sorry shadow of its former glorious self…
en_us.152402_fluff: When the time of the White Frost comes, Hemdall will sound the call for battle.
en_us.152402_tooltip: Destroy all other units and clear all <keyword=boon>Boons</keyword> and <keyword=hazard>Hazards</keyword>.
en_us.152403_fluff: "Ehh, too big for a humpback. That's a finback." "A finback? With a snout that short? Those herbs've gone to your head!"
en_us.152403_tooltip: <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>.\nMove to a random row and deal {Damage} damage to all other units on it on turn end.
en_us.152406_fluff: We're going on a bear hunt! We're going to catch a–– THAT THING'S HUGE! RUN!
en_us.153201_fluff: Those cursed sorceresses are stealing our thunder! Whyever should folk choose a procedure taking several hours, when some perfumed tart can solve their problem with a wave of her hand?
en_us.153201_tooltip: Return a Bronze or Silver Skellige unit from your graveyard to your hand, add the <keyword=doomed>Doomed</keyword> category to it, and set its base power to {Set}. Then play a card.
en_us.153301_fluff: A sight more horrid you've never seen… The poor soul lay shredded as the beast lapped up its blood from the ground all around.
en_us.153301_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to all units on a row.
en_us.162101_fluff: Witchers never die in their beds.
en_us.162101_tooltip: <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>.\nApply <keyword=lock>Lock</keyword> status to {MaxTargets} units on this row, then <keyword=drain>Drain</keyword> all their power.
en_us.162102_fluff: I'll take an attentive reconnaissance unit over a fine brigade any day.
en_us.162102_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy. If it's <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>, destroy it instead.
en_us.162103_fluff: There's never been a problem a well–planned assassination couldn't solve.
en_us.162103_tooltip: <keyword=reveal>Reveal</keyword> up to {MaxTargets} of your cards, then <keyword=reveal>Reveal</keyword> the same number of your opponent's randomly.
en_us.162104_fluff: His eyes flashed under his winged helmet. Fire gleamed from his sword's blade.
en_us.162105_fluff: We are all pawns on his board. Playing a game whose rules we do not know.
en_us.162105_tooltip: Destroy an ally, then play the top card of your deck; or <keyword=truce>Truce:</keyword> Destroy an enemy, then your opponent draws and <keyword=reveal>Reveals</keyword> a Bronze card.
en_us.162106_fluff: My mark scars the face of our future empress. That is my proudest achievement.
en_us.162106_tooltip: Move any card in your deck to the top. If it's a non-<keyword=spying>Spying</keyword> unit, boost it by {Boost}.
en_us.162107_fluff: Tibor's zeal was legendary. It was said when the emperor passed, he'd not so much bow as somersault.
en_us.162107_tooltip: <keyword=truce>Truce:</keyword> Boost self by {Boost}, then your opponent draws a <keyword=revealed>Revealed</keyword> Bronze card.
en_us.162108_fluff: Astrology, hydromancy, haruspicy, ceromancy. Ovomancy, spodomancy, metroscopy, brontoscopy…
en_us.162108_tooltip: Look at your opponent's deck and move a card to the bottom.
en_us.162201_fluff: A ball of fire? Why, naturally. Whatsoever Your Imperial Majesty desires.
en_us.162201_tooltip: <keyword=truce>Truce:</keyword> Each player draws a card. The opponent's card is <keyword=revealed>Revealed</keyword>.
en_us.162202_fluff: Nilfgaardian mages do have a choice: servile submission, or the gallows.
en_us.162202_tooltip: Return {MaxTargets} Bronze or Silver cards from either graveyard to their respective decks.
en_us.162203_fluff: Cynthia's talents can be deadly. She needs a tight leash.
en_us.162203_tooltip: <keyword=reveal>Reveal</keyword> the <keyword=highest>Highest</keyword> unit in your opponent's hand and boost self by its power.
en_us.162204_fluff: These are not the hands of an "Excellency," but of a farmer. So we speak peasant to peasant.
en_us.162204_tooltip: <keyword=reset>Reset</keyword> an ally and <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> it by {Strengthen}; or <keyword=reset>Reset</keyword> an enemy and <keyword=weaken>Weaken</keyword> it by {Weaken}.
en_us.162205_fluff: Magic is the highest good. It transcends all borders and divisions.
en_us.162205_tooltip: <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>.\nCopy the power from the unit to the left to the unit to the right.
en_us.162206_fluff: And hands off the girl! Whatever we may be, we're not savages.
en_us.162206_tooltip: Choose an enemy or a <keyword=revealed>Revealed</keyword> unit in your opponent's hand, then move all copies of it from their deck to the graveyard.
en_us.162207_fluff: For a fire mage, he's not very… flamboyant.
en_us.162207_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> Biting Frost, Clear Skies or Shrike.
en_us.162208_fluff: Letho's got a plan… what could go wrong?
en_us.162209_fluff: We do what we must. I am not ashamed of that.
en_us.162209_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy; or Set a <keyword=revealed>Revealed</keyword> opposing unit's power to {Set}.
en_us.162210_fluff: Men require constant alluring. Mystique and refinement do the job quite well.
en_us.162210_tooltip: <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>.\n<keyword=fatigue>Single-Use:</keyword> Draw {MaxTargets} cards. Keep one and move the other to the bottom of your deck.
en_us.162211_fluff: To describe the manner in which Duke de Wett led the Verden Group as "incompetent" would be far too kind.
en_us.162211_tooltip: <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>.\nPlay the top non-<keyword=spying>Spying</keyword> Bronze or Silver unit from your deck and boost it by {Boost}.
en_us.162212_fluff: "Here she comes," he thought, "our imperial interest. A mock-princess, a mock-queen for Cintra. A mock-ruler for the mouth of the Yarra, future lifeblood of the empire."
en_us.162212_tooltip: <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>. If <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>, boost self by {Boost} on turn start and when this player passes, move to the opposite row.\n<keyword=deathwish>Deathwish:</keyword> Destroy the <keyword=lowest>Lowest</keyword> unit on the row.
en_us.162213_fluff: "Your Imperial Highness…" blurted out the seneschal, whose presence until now had been thoroughly ignored. "I beg your pardon, but Cahir… My son..."
en_us.162301_fluff: Learned a lot at Braibant Military Academy. How to scrub potatoes, for instance.
en_us.162301_tooltip: Whenever you <keyword=reveal>Reveal</keyword> this unit, play it automatically on a random row and draw a card.
en_us.162302_fluff: Let historians debate whether spreading plague in a besieged city is ethical. We just care if it's effective.
en_us.162302_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> a Cow Carcass on an enemy row.
en_us.162303_fluff: The North has nothing with which it could surprise us.
en_us.162303_tooltip: Boost self by the base power of a <keyword=revealed>Revealed</keyword> Bronze or Silver unit.
en_us.162304_fluff: The world has known as many plagues as it has wars. Yet both war and plague always take men by surprise.
en_us.162304_tooltip: <keyword=resurrect>Resurrect</keyword> a Bronze unit from your opponent's graveyard.
en_us.162305_fluff: I aim for the knees. Always.
en_us.162305_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy. If it's <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>, deal {Damage2} damage instead.
en_us.162306_fluff: Name's terribly misleading, makes it sound like some corpulent reddish arachnid, not an exquisitely engineered weapon of mass destruction...
en_us.162306_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy.\nWhenever you <keyword=reveal>Reveal</keyword> this unit, trigger its ability.
en_us.162307_fluff: The Impera Brigade never surrenders. Ever.
en_us.162307_tooltip: Boost self by {Boost} for each <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword> enemy. Boost self by {Boost} whenever a <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword> enemy appears.
en_us.162308_fluff: Members of the emperor's fanatic body guard fight to the bitter end.
en_us.162308_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy.\nFor each <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword> enemy that appears during your turn, deal {Damage} damage to an enemy on turn end.
en_us.162309_fluff: The Emperor will teach the North discipline.
en_us.162309_tooltip: Clear <keyword=hazard>Hazards</keyword> from its row and boost an ally or a <keyword=revealed>Revealed</keyword> unit in your hand by {Boost}.
en_us.162310_fluff: They call us Death's Heads. Care to find out why?
en_us.162310_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to a <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword> unit. If it was destroyed, <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> self by {Strengthen}.
en_us.162311_fluff: Pledge your allegiance to our Emperor, Emhyr var Emreis… or die.
en_us.162311_tooltip: <keyword=summon>Summon</keyword> all copies of this unit to this row.
en_us.162312_tooltip: Boost self by {Boost} whenever either player draws a card.
en_us.162313_fluff: Want irrefutable proof of civilization's advance? Look at war. Man gets better at killing with each one.
en_us.162314_fluff: But… but there's no justice in it! One does not kill the messenger!
en_us.162314_tooltip: <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>.\nLook at {MaxTargets} random Bronze units from your deck, then play {MaxTargets2}.
en_us.162315_fluff: A spy? No, that's saying far too much. I consider myself more of an observer.
en_us.162316_fluff: Two ounces of calcium equum, one ounce of rubedo…
en_us.162317_fluff: This model specializes in slinging corpses and ripe dung.
en_us.162317_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to a random enemy.\nRepeat this ability whenever you <keyword=reveal>Reveal</keyword> a card.
en_us.162318_fluff: Sons of noble houses, born in the City of the Golden Towers, form the elite backbone of the Imperial Army.
en_us.162318_tooltip: <keyword=reveal>Reveal</keyword> a random card in your hand, with priority given to Bronze, then Silver, then Gold.\n{Armor} <keyword=armor>Armor</keyword>.
en_us.162401_fluff: Stone fists to stop intruders armed with swords. Ironclad logic to stop those armed with lies.
en_us.162401_tooltip: Add a Lesser Guardian to the top of your opponent's deck.
en_us.162402_fluff: That a bird? That a griffin? Naye! That's a…
en_us.162402_tooltip: <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>.\nAfter {Counter} turns, destroy all the other <keyword=lowest>Lowest</keyword> units on the row and <keyword=banish>Banish</keyword> self on turn end.
en_us.163101_fluff:
"How much is a human life worth?"
"That depends. Yours, for instance, I'd put at about a hundred orens."
en_us.163101_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy. Repeat once.
en_us.163201_fluff: Many believe the empire's power rests upon the shoulders of its disciplined army and dutiful mages. In truth, the Nilfgaardian floren rules the world.
en_us.163201_tooltip: Force {MaxTargets} adjacent enemies to <keyword=duel>Duel</keyword> each other.
en_us.200008_fluff: But that night, the moon was the color of blood.
en_us.200009_fluff: While deadly for men, Potions are merely toxic for witchers. Yet even they must measure every drop, lest they exceed the maximum dosage... and pay the maximum price.
en_us.200018_fluff: Vicovaro scholars have determined that, in the absence of imperial aid, drought-stricken provinces lose half their population, two-thirds of their livestock and all their will to rebel.
en_us.200018_tooltip: Apply a <keyword=hazard>Hazard</keyword> to each enemy row that deals {Damage} damage to the <keyword=lowest>Lowest</keyword> unit on turn start.
en_us.200019_fluff: We are but pawns in a game played by old men, sent to fight and die on their senile whims…
en_us.200019_tooltip: Boost the <keyword=lowest>Lowest</keyword> Bronze or Silver unit in your deck by {Boost}, then play it.
en_us.200020_fluff: We have ways of making you talk… alive or dead.
en_us.200020_tooltip: <keyword=banish>Banish</keyword> a Bronze or Silver unit from either graveyard, then boost an ally by its power.
en_us.200021_fluff: First we ran into a bear… things just got worse from there.
en_us.200022_fluff: There exist a great many realities outside our own… With the right knowledge, one can contact them and summon beings beyond human fathoming.
en_us.200022_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> a default copy of the last Bronze or Silver non-Agent unit that appeared.
en_us.200023_fluff: "If substance makes contact with eyes, rinse immediately with cold water, then commence drawing up will."
en_us.200026_fluff: For hundreds of years, Avallac'h tried to recreate the Elder Blood gene through back breeding - yet the elven children thus fostered were but dim sparks compared to Lara's flame.
en_us.200026_tooltip: Choose a Bronze non-Mage Wild Hunt ally and play a copy of it from your deck.
en_us.200028_fluff: Blood for Svalblod! Skulls for his throne!
en_us.200028_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy. If it was already damaged, destroy it instead.
en_us.200030_fluff: The old baron treated poachers mercilessly. Luckily for Milaen, the old baron was dead and his men, desperate outlaws.
en_us.200030_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to the units at the end of a row.
en_us.200031_fluff: He would just sit there and stare at me, not saying a word. His eyes, they were… fish-like, somehow. No brows, no lashes… Just these balls of water, with a black stone sunk in each. He would devour me with those eyes in total silence. That frightened me more than the beatings.
en_us.200031_tooltip: <keyword=reveal>Reveal</keyword> one of your units and deal damage equal to its base power to an enemy.
en_us.200032_fluff: When Cintra fell, Attre followed, leaving its defenders a choice: accept the Nilfgaardian leash or die.
en_us.200032_tooltip: Play a Bronze or Silver <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword> unit from your deck.
en_us.200033_fluff: The adepts' every whim is catered to - they live like princesses at Aretuza. And in turn half the city lives off servicing them: seamstresses, milliners, confectioners, delivery boys…
en_us.200033_tooltip: Play a random Bronze <keyword=hazard>Hazard</keyword> from your deck.
en_us.200036_fluff: Think o' the greater good?! War's the greatest good, the greatest bad, the greatest damn anythin' man's ever come up with!
en_us.200036_tooltip: <keyword=discard>Discard</keyword> a Bronze card from your deck.
en_us.200037_fluff: Don't stare at his eye, he hates that…
en_us.200037_tooltip: Destroy an ally and deal damage equal to its power to an enemy.
en_us.200038_fluff: Folklore claims they sprout from soil watered with the blood of the dying. Thus they flourish in grounds consecrated by pogroms, dark rituals or brutal murders.
en_us.200038_tooltip: Move to a random row and deal {Damage} damage to a random enemy on turn start.\n<keyword=deathwish>Deathwish:</keyword> Deal {Damage2} damage to a random enemy.
en_us.200039_fluff: As long as we stand, no human foot shall trample Dol Blathanna's meadows.
en_us.200039_tooltip: If in hand, deck or on board, boost self by {Boost} whenever you play a special card.
en_us.200040_fluff: Ahh, ye gave me a good laugh there, Nordling! Why, this bastard, ye couldn't even grip it, let alone gut me with it.
en_us.200040_tooltip: Every {Counter} turns, if damaged, <keyword=heal>Heal</keyword> self and <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> by {Strengthen} on turn start.
en_us.200041_fluff: Not the best for taking cities, but great for razing them to the ground.
en_us.200041_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to all enemies except those on the opposite row. If this unit was <keyword=revealed>Revealed</keyword>, deal damage to all enemies instead.
en_us.200042_fluff: Hunting on Mahakam's craggy cliffs is not particularly easy… but nor are dwarves particularly put off by danger.
en_us.200042_tooltip: Whenever this unit's power changes, except when <keyword=reset>Reset</keyword>, boost self by {Boost}.
en_us.200043_fluff: Once proud jarl of Clan Tordarroch, now a muttering madman.
en_us.200043_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> Wilfred to the left of this unit, Wilhelm to the right, and Wilmar on the opposite row.
en_us.200044_fluff: I know the Emperor defends all his lands... but a garrison in this blasted waste is like a chastity belt on a grave hag.
en_us.200044_tooltip: Play a random Bronze Item from your deck.
en_us.200046_fluff: In my days I've seen wonders no man's ever dreamt of, and done things no man should ever do.
en_us.200046_tooltip: <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> all your other Clan Tuirseach units in hand, deck, and on board by {Strengthen}.
en_us.200048_fluff: I'm constantly comparing the achievements of Aretuza's adepts with the work done by the lads at Ban Ard, and my conclusion constantly falls in favor of the girls.
en_us.200048_tooltip: <keyword=swap>Swap</keyword> a card in your hand with a Bronze special card from your deck.
en_us.200049_fluff: Not gonna open up, eh? Guess we gotta knock harder.
en_us.200049_tooltip:
Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy. If it's destroyed, deal {Damage2} damage to another enemy.
<keyword=crewed>Crewed:</keyword> Increase initial damage by {Damage3}.
en_us.200050_fluff: The Great Sun shall warm the North with its rays, even if it means I must slaughter you all!
en_us.200052_fluff: Some claim Golyat was once a famous knight. Sadly, one day he earned the wrath of the Lady of the Lake, who turned him into a monster.
en_us.200052_tooltip: Boost self by {Boost}.\nWhenever this unit is damaged, deal {Damage} damage to self.
en_us.200053_fluff: The figurine expanded in a flash, pulsing and throbbing, changing its shape and structure like a puff of smoke crawling over the floor. Beams of light revealed movement and hardening materials. A moment later, in the center of the magic circle a human form suddenly appeared.
en_us.200053_tooltip: Transform a Bronze or Silver unit into a Jade Figurine.
en_us.200055_fluff: No one, not even among the higher vampires, knows exactly how old the Unseen Elder is. They only know they should never, under any circumstances, defy his will.
en_us.200056_fluff: Ever heard of an "anterion"? Think of it as the opposite of a lycanthrope: a beast which can take on human form.
en_us.200057_fluff: I inherited my father's ability to assume other forms - well, one other form, in my case.
en_us.200058_fluff: I give you three solid leads, trails as fresh as morning dew, the aid of my spies and my court sorceress. Yet in my daughter's stead, you bring me this… monstrosity?
en_us.200062_fluff: Smarten up right now, or it's off to an aguara with you!
en_us.200062_tooltip: Choose Two: Boost the <keyword=lowest>Lowest</keyword> ally by {Boost}; Boost a random unit in your hand by {Boost2}; Deal {Damage} damage to the <keyword=highest>Highest</keyword> enemy; <keyword=charm>Charm</keyword> a random enemy Elf with {Power} power or less.
en_us.200067_fluff: When the moon is full, nightmares crawl out of all the dark nooks and crannies of the world.
en_us.200067_tooltip: Choose One: Apply a Full Moon <keyword=boon>Boon</keyword>; or Apply a Blood Moon <keyword=hazard>Hazard</keyword>.
en_us.200071_fluff: A diplomat is a man who uses many more words than necessary to express much less than he knows.
en_us.200071_tooltip: <keyword=truce>Truce:</keyword> Draw a card from both decks. Keep one and give the other to your opponent.
en_us.200073_fluff: And the striga's doin' fine. Sure, she takes a bite outta someone from time to time, but you get used to that.
en_us.200073_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to a non-Monster faction unit.
en_us.200078_fluff: Imagine a lump of clay. In order to shape it, you must first moisten it or it will crumble. The Trial's initial part does just that. It opens the body to change, so to speak. Only then can the mutagens produce a witcher.
en_us.200078_tooltip: Boost a Witcher to {Boost} power; or Deal {Damage} damage to a non-Witcher unit. If it survives, boost it to {Boost} power.
en_us.200079_fluff: This spell lets you see the last moments of a dead man's life… if you can survive its casting.
en_us.200079_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> a default copy of a non-Leader Gold unit from your opponent's graveyard and boost it by {Boost}.
en_us.200080_fluff: Well? Somethin' wrong? Venison a wee bit rank for ye? Ehh, princess?
en_us.200080_tooltip: Boost this unit by the default power of the last other Dwarf you played.
en_us.200081_fluff: "We don't burn cunning women in Skellige - we take their advice."
en_us.200081_tooltip: Play a random Bronze Organic or <keyword=hazard>Hazard</keyword> card from your deck.
en_us.200083_fluff: We'd rather keep our names to ourselves. Think of us as… friends of the house.
en_us.200083_tooltip: Move a card from your deck to your hand, then <keyword=discard>Discard</keyword> a random card.
en_us.200087_fluff: Like the witchers, Dorregaray is a monster aficionado, though he's developed his own classification system. Instead of dividing them into necrophages, ogroids and the like, he just thinks they're all wonderful.
en_us.200087_tooltip: <keyword=create>Create</keyword> any Bronze or Silver Beast or Draconid.
en_us.200088_fluff: The coroner is a calm, peaceful person. He even treats corpses with the utmost delicacy.
en_us.200088_tooltip: <keyword=drain>Drain</keyword> all boosts from units in your deck.
en_us.200089_fluff: Lost? Well, go be lost somewhere else. Somewhere not on my property, that is. Point your left ear to the sun and keep walking, you'll hit the road soon enough. Well? What're you waiting for?
en_us.200089_tooltip: Move all units on a row to random rows.
en_us.200091_fluff: The witcher had met thieves that looked like town councilors, town councilors that looked like beggars and kings that looked like thieves. Stregobor, though, always looked exactly like the commonly accepted imagining of a what a mage should look like.
en_us.200091_tooltip: <keyword=truce>Truce:</keyword> Each player draws a unit and sets its power to {Set}.
en_us.200098_fluff: By day, Captain of the Vizima City Guard. By night, merciless avenger and defender of the downtrodden.
en_us.200098_tooltip: Destroy the <keyword=armor>Armor</keyword> of all units, then boost self by half the value destroyed.
en_us.200102_fluff: The gods' speak to me… I hear them whisper from the shadows…
en_us.200102_tooltip: Choose One: Play a Bronze or Silver Cursed unit from your deck; or <keyword=create>Create</keyword> a Silver unit from your opponent's starting deck.
en_us.200103_fluff: 10-time winner of the venerable title of Champion of the An Skellig Arena.
en_us.200103_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to self. Reduce the damage inflicted by {Boost} for each Beast you played this match.
en_us.200104_fluff: Werewolf? Oh, no, no… this is something far, far worse.
en_us.200104_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to all enemies. If they were already damaged, deal {Damage2} damage instead.
en_us.200105_fluff: Clan Dimun warships are light and fast, perfect for racing down slow merchant frigates.
en_us.200105_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to the same unit {Counter} times.
en_us.200112_fluff: Legends claim they lure sailors to their doom with their entrancing songs… though more likely, the sailors were more entranced by their other ample charms.
en_us.200114_fluff: Some say lycanthropy's contagious - get bit by a werewolf, you turn into one yourself. Witchers know that's nonsense, of course - only a powerful curse can bring on this condition.
en_us.200114_tooltip: <keyword=spawn>Spawn</keyword> a Wolf on each side of this unit on contact with Full Moon.
en_us.200115_fluff: One of the most popular professions at the imperial court, just after scribe and courtesan.
en_us.200115_tooltip: <keyword=spying>Spying</keyword>.\nDeal {Damage} damage to the unit to the left.
en_us.200118_fluff: You can run, but you'll never hide.
en_us.200124_fluff: The School of the Viper shall be reborn… Letho saw to that.
en_us.200124_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage for each Alchemy card in your starting deck.
en_us.200132_fluff: Who are the witch hunters? Scoundrels and fanatics, for the most part, though after the foul deeds perpetrated by the Lodge of Sorceress, many a decent man, outraged to the hilt, joined their ranks...
en_us.200132_tooltip: <keyword=reset>Reset</keyword> a unit. If it's a Mage, play a copy of this unit from your deck.
en_us.200135_fluff: An extraordinarily risky, and thus much revered, Mahakam trade. Its best-known practitioner was a dwarf by the name of Mikkel Bay.
en_us.200135_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to a random enemy on each row.
en_us.200136_fluff: Her words might seem unintelligible at times, but they always contain hidden meanings and tremendous wisdom.
en_us.200136_tooltip: If any of your other allies or units in hand are boosted during your turn, boost self by {Boost} on turn end.
en_us.200138_fluff: Knowledge, my dear, is a privilege, and privileges are only shared among equals.
en_us.200138_tooltip: <keyword=resurrect>Resurrect</keyword> a Bronze Alchemy or Spell card, then <keyword=banish>Banish</keyword> it.
en_us.200139_fluff: An Oxenfurt scholar once examined a panther and declared it was nothing more than a leopard of a different color. The panther seemed indifferent to this pronouncement and gobbled him up before he could complete his research.
en_us.200139_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to an enemy on a row with less than {Counter} units.
en_us.200144_fluff: Don't touch him. Don't look him in the eyes. In fact… don't go anywhere near him.
en_us.200145_fluff: The sea's ours, along with everythin' that floats, swims or sails in it!
en_us.200146_fluff: Spikeroog's a barren backwater, but that don't bother us - everythin' we need, we take from you.
en_us.200146_tooltip: Return a Bronze unit from your graveyard to your deck.
en_us.200147_fluff: A flaminica, the highest position among the druidesses, commands a great deal of respect and wields a great deal of power.
en_us.200147_tooltip: Clear <keyword=hazard>Hazards</keyword> from the row and move {MaxTargets} allies to it.
en_us.200149_fluff: He fears nothing save Freya's wrath... and his wife's.
en_us.200149_tooltip: Play a Bronze Item from your deck.
en_us.200154_fluff: We, Foltest, by divine right King of Temeria, Prince of Sodden, Senior Protector of Brugge, etcetera, etcetera, do hereby decree the following…
en_us.200154_tooltip: Play a Gold unit from your deck and boost it by {Boost}.
en_us.200158_fluff: That is not dead which can eternal lie, and with strange aeons even death may die.
en_us.200159_fluff: No one can replace Bran. Though they're sure to try.
en_us.200159_tooltip: <keyword=discard>Discard</keyword> up to {MaxTargets} cards from your deck and <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> them by {Strengthen}.
en_us.200160_fluff: Nilfgaardians call 'im Tirth ys Muire, the Wild Boar o' the Sea. Use 'im to scare their kiddies!
en_us.200160_tooltip: <keyword=strengthen>Strengthen</keyword> the <keyword=highest>Highest</keyword> non-<keyword=spying>Spying</keyword> Bronze or Silver unit in your deck by {Strengthen} and play it.
en_us.200161_fluff: No one knows how he got his nickname – no one's dared to ask.
en_us.200161_tooltip: Deal {Damage} damage to a random enemy on the opposite row. Repeat {Counter} times.
en_us.200162_fluff: They do not call me the Patient. Take care they do not call you the Headless.
en_us.200162_tooltip: Play a card, then return a Bronze or Silver ally to your hand.
en_us.200163_fluff: The summer sun reflected in the quiet waters of the Alba – that's Nilfgaard to me.

<keyword=crewed>Crewed:</keyword> Repeat its ability.
en_us.201749_fluff: Smell that? That's the smell of happiness.
